ankunft.text: Welcome home! {nickname} is already looking around curiously. Let me quickly show you around — no rush.

streicheln.text: Tap {nickname} and give a little pet. Gooby loves that more than anything.
streicheln.feier: Hehe, that tickles! {nickname} beams at you.

fuettern.text: The fridge in the kitchen is full of treats. Give {nickname} something to eat.
fuettern.feier: Yum! A full tummy makes a happy Gooby.

waschen.text: The bathtub is ready in the bathroom. Give {nickname} a good scrub.
waschen.feier: Squeaky clean! {nickname} smells like fresh laundry.

muenzen.text: You earn coins by playing and caring — even petting pays off. Earn your first coins!
muenzen.feier: Cha-ching! Your first coins are in.

minispiel.text: Open the arcade in the dock below and play a round — the first round of the day counts double!
minispiel.feier: What a round! Minigames earn coins and XP.

moebel.text: Browse the furniture store or the shop and buy a little something for your home.
moebel.feier: So cozy! {nickname} is trying it out right away.

sticker.text: Almost everything you do earns stickers for the album. One is surely waiting for you already!
sticker.feier: A sticker for the album! Collectors, rejoice.

ausblick.titel: The Rest Is Yours to Discover
ausblick.text: Out there the city, the arcade, and from level 20 the Gooby Ranch are waiting. And every day brings three fresh daily quests — check the Quests button!
